name: Assign marker sequences to published ribotypes
description: Assign each sequence from an earlier fetch_markers step to the nearest ribotype in a curated, versioned reference panel by deterministic k-mer similarity. Returns the ribotype, score, distance and margin, and leaves low-score, low-margin and uncovered-region sequences unassigned. Runs locally with no source request.
planner_guidance: Call assign_ribotype only after fetch_markers completed for the same taxon and marker.
A curated panel exists for Margalefidinium polykrikoides LSU only; other taxa and markers are refused.
Unassigned sequences are results, not failures: they mark novel variants or regions the panel does not cover.
A ribotype is not a strain identity or a growth phenotype; strains with identical LSU differ in thermal response.

arguments.name: taxon
arguments.description: The taxon of a completed fetch_markers step.

arguments.name: marker
arguments.description: Marker of the completed fetch_markers step and of the panel.

sources: Curated reference panel shipped with Sewall.ai; sequences from an earlier fetch_markers step

limitations: Panel labels are inferred from isolate origin in the source publications and need a full-text check.
Scores are k-mer similarity proxies, not alignments or phylogenetic placements.
Intragenomic LSU variation can exceed differences between closely related ribotypes.
A ribotype call does not give a growth parameter.

policy_constraints.attribution: Cite the panel version, the source publication of each reference label, and the GenBank accessions assigned.
